limitations: These cases were selected by previous results; no population success rate or training-cause inference.
A candidate face illegal elsewhere is not proof that its nearest point is an intersection. Corresponding-C-owner relationship remains a whole-face annotation.
Tangential gaps are Euclidean nearest-point displacement projected into the local source C tangent plane; this supplementary decomposition changes no scorer.
A normal ray may hit sides or distant structure; multiple groups do not independently certify duplicate seats or invalid thickness.
Long-edge midpoints naturally lie far from edge endpoint vertices even when a legal edge is present; only separate source boundary-vertex queries diagnose endpoint alignment.
Source-normal sign is not inside/outside or an unverified global up/down label.
F local IDs may change at POST; no RAW/POST face-identity correspondence is assumed.
